---
pagetitle: "Source passages · Light Logger Inventory"
description: "Read the passages behind the wearable light logger inventory."
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import html, json
from pathlib import Path

library = json.loads(Path('data/library.json').read_text())
evidence = json.loads(Path('data/source-evidence.json').read_text())
data = {'studies': [{k:s[k] for k in ['id','title','authors','year','doi','url']} for s in library['studies']], 'evidence':evidence}
encoded = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).replace('<', r'\u003c').replace('>', r'\u003e').replace('&', r'\u0026')
fragment = Path('assets/source-page.html').read_text().replace('@@SOURCE_DATA@@',encoded)
print('```{=html}\n'+fragment+'\n```')
```
